extracted.name: Bengali Style Fish Fry and British Fried fish Fusion with Mango Beer batter
extracted.description: This summer while I was getting my first tattoo, I had the best fish fry while it was raining in Kolkata right before my appointment and I’ve been missing it and I noticed there was caught in my fridge as well as one can of mango beer as well as unused kasundhi and came this amazing fusion dish! Take me right back!
ingredient_lines: 5 tbsp (for batter) + 1/2 can (for serving) Golden Road Mango Cart Mango Wheat Ale
instruction_lines: Marinate fish with green chili paste, MSG, salt, lemon juice, and ginger garlic paste for 2 hours.
Mix corn flour, all-purpose flour, and beer to make a smooth batter.
Heat mustard oil and ghee in a pan to medium-high.
Dip marinated fish in batter, coat well.
Fry fish until golden and crisp on both sides.
Serve hot with kasundi and half a can of the same mango wheat ale used in the batter.
